+func TestConsistentHashCELValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	v := NewKgatewayValidator(t)
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name    string
+		yaml    string
+		wantErr bool
+	}{
+		{
+			name: "empty consistentHash is valid",
+			yaml: `
+apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
+kind: TrafficPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: tp-empty-ch
+spec:
+  consistentHash: {}
+`,
+			wantErr: false,
+		},
+		{
+			name: "disable true alone is valid",
+			yaml: `
+apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
+kind: TrafficPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: tp-disable-ch
+spec:
+  consistentHash:
+    disable: true
+`,
+			wantErr: false,
+		},
+		{
+			name: "disable true with headers is invalid",
+			yaml: `
+apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
+kind: TrafficPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: tp-disable-with-headers
+spec:
+  consistentHash:
+    disable: true
+    headers:
+    - headerName: X-Foo
+`,
+			wantErr: true,
+		},
+		{
+			name: "disable true with sourceIp is invalid",
+			yaml: `
+apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
+kind: TrafficPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: tp-disable-with-sourceip
+spec:
+  consistentHash:
+    disable: true
+    sourceIp:
+      terminal: true
+`,
+			wantErr: true,
+		},
+		{
+			name: "all consistentHash sub-fields are valid",
+			yaml: `
+apiVersion: gateway.kgateway.dev/v1alpha1
+kind: TrafficPolicy
+metadata:
+  name: tp-full-ch
+spec:
+  consistentHash:
+    headers:
+    - headerName: X-User-Id
+      regexRewrite:
+        pattern: "^user-(.*)"
+        substitution: "\\1"
+      terminal: true
+    cookies:
+    - name: session-id
+      ttl: "3600"
+      path: /
+      attributes:
+      - name: SameSite
+        value: Lax
+      - name: Secure
+        value: "true"
+      terminal: false
+    queryParameters:
+    - name: user
+      terminal: false
+    filterState:
+    - key: envoy.network.application_protocol
+      terminal: false
+    sourceIp:
+      terminal: true
+`,
+			wantErr: false,
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			obj := &unstructured.Unstructured{}
+			require.NoError(t, yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(tt.yaml), obj))
+			err := v.ValidateCustomResource(obj)
+			if tt.wantErr {
+				require.Error(t, err)
+			} else {
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"slices"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	envoyroutev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/config/route/v3"
+	envoy_type_matcher_v3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/type/matcher/v3"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/durationpb"
+	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/util/sets"
+
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway"
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/pkg/utils/regexutils"
+)
+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	disable      bool
+	defaulted    bool
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return c == nil && otherCH == nil
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherCH.disable || c.defaulted != otherCH.defaulted {
+		return false
+	}
+	return slices.EqualFunc(c.hashPolicies, otherCH.hashPolicies, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+		return proto.Equal(a, b)
+	})
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+		if hp == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		if hdr := hp.GetHeader(); hdr != nil && hdr.GetRegexRewrite() != nil && hdr.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern() != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(hdr.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern().GetRegex()); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+		if err := hp.Validate(); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) clone() *consistentHashIR {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	cloned := &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:   c.disable,
+		defaulted: c.defaulted,
+	}
+	if len(c.hashPolicies) > 0 {
+		cloned.hashPolicies = make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, len(c.hashPolicies))
+		for i, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+			if hp != nil {
+				cloned.hashPolicies[i] = proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return cloned
+}

+func parseCookieTTL(ttl string) (*durationpb.Duration, error) {
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttl, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: must be non-negative", ttl)
+		}
+		return durationpb.New(time.Duration(secs) * time.Second), nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttl)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: %w", ttl, err)
+	}
+	if d < 0 {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: must be non-negative", ttl)
+	}
+	return durationpb.New(d), nil
+}

+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	if ch.Disable {
+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIp != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disable: true,
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	var hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. Headers (case-insensitive deduplication preserving casing of first occurrence)
+	seenHeaders := sets.New[string]()
+	for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+		key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+		if seenHeaders.Has(key) {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenHeaders.Insert(key)
+
+		headerPolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern %q in consistentHash header %q: %w", h.RegexRewrite.Pattern, h.HeaderName, err)
+			}
+			headerPolicy.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: headerPolicy,
+			},
+			Terminal: h.Terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies (deduplicated by name)
+	seenCookies := sets.New[string]()
+	for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+		if seenCookies.Has(c.Name) {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenCookies.Insert(c.Name)
+
+		var ttlProto *durationpb.Duration
+		if c.TTL != "" {
+			var err error
+			ttlProto, err = parseCookieTTL(c.TTL)
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+
+		var attrs []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute
+		if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+			attrs = make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(c.Attributes))
+			for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+				attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  attr.Name,
+					Value: attr.Value,
+				})
+			}
+		}
+
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+					Name:       c.Name,
+					Ttl:        ttlProto,
+					Path:       c.Path,
+					Attributes: attrs,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: c.Terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters (deduplicated by name)
+	seenQueryParams := sets.New[string]()
+	for _, qp := range ch.QueryParameters {
+		if seenQueryParams.Has(qp.Name) {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenQueryParams.Insert(qp.Name)
+
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: qp.Name,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: qp.Terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState (deduplicated by key)
+	seenFilterState := sets.New[string]()
+	for _, fs := range ch.FilterState {
+		if seenFilterState.Has(fs.Key) {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenFilterState.Insert(fs.Key)
+
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: fs.Key,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: fs.Terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 5. SourceIp
+	if ch.SourceIp != nil {
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ch.SourceIp.Terminal,
+		})
+	}
+
+	// If no sub-fields are specified, default to a single sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false.
+	defaulted := false
+	if len(hashPolicies) == 0 {
+		defaulted = true
+		hashPolicies = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			defaultSourceIPHashPolicy(),
+		}
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies: hashPolicies,
+		defaulted:    defaulted,
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(consistentHash *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if consistentHash == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if consistentHash.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	if len(consistentHash.hashPolicies) == 0 {
+		action.HashPolicy = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			defaultSourceIPHashPolicy(),
+		}
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = consistentHash.hashPolicies
+}
+
+func hashPolicyTypeRank(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) int {
+	if hp == nil {
+		return 5
+	}
+	switch hp.GetPolicySpecifier().(type) {
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_:
+		return 0
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_:
+		return 1
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_:
+		return 2
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_:
+		return 3
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_:
+		return 4
+	default:
+		return 5
+	}
+}
+
+func mergeConsistentHashIR(high, low *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	seenHeaders := sets.New[string]()
+	seenCookies := sets.New[string]()
+	seenQueryParams := sets.New[string]()
+	seenFilterState := sets.New[string]()
+	seenSourceIP := false
+
+	var merged []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	addPolicies := func(policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, allowSourceIP bool) {
+		for _, hp := range policies {
+			if hp == nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			switch spec := hp.GetPolicySpecifier().(type) {
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_:
+				key := strings.ToLower(spec.Header.GetHeaderName())
+				if seenHeaders.Has(key) {
+					continue
+				}
+				seenHeaders.Insert(key)
+				merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_:
+				key := spec.Cookie.GetName()
+				if seenCookies.Has(key) {
+					continue
+				}
+				seenCookies.Insert(key)
+				merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_:
+				key := spec.QueryParameter.GetName()
+				if seenQueryParams.Has(key) {
+					continue
+				}
+				seenQueryParams.Insert(key)
+				merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_:
+				key := spec.FilterState.GetKey()
+				if seenFilterState.Has(key) {
+					continue
+				}
+				seenFilterState.Insert(key)
+				merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_:
+				if !allowSourceIP || seenSourceIP {
+					continue
+				}
+				seenSourceIP = true
+				merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	if high != nil {
+		addPolicies(high.hashPolicies, !high.defaulted)
+	}
+	if low != nil {
+		// sourceIp scalar retains the higher-priority policy's value even when unset
+		addPolicies(low.hashPolicies, false)
+	}
+
+	// Re-sort into canonical type order: headers, cookies, queryParameters, filterState, sourceIp
+	slices.SortStableFunc(merged, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) int {
+		return hashPolicyTypeRank(a) - hashPolicyTypeRank(b)
+	})
+
+	defaulted := false
+	if len(merged) == 0 {
+		defaulted = true
+		merged = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			defaultSourceIPHashPolicy(),
+		}
+	}
+
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies: merged,
+		defaulted:    defaulted,
+	}
+}

+func mergeConsistentHash(

+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,

+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	switch opts.Strategy {
+	case policy.OverridableShallowMerge, policy.OverridableDeepMerge:
+		if p1.spec.consistentHash.disable {

+		}

+		mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+
+	default:
+		if p1.spec.consistentHash.disable {
+			return
+		}
+		if p2.spec.consistentHash.disable {

+		}
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = mergeConsistentHashIR(p1.spec.consistentHash, p2.spec.consistentHash)
